title: KnotUp 1.2.6
description: Improve light-mode feature icon contrast with bright tinted backgrounds and clear glyphs.
Show live word and character counts under the Notes editor while typing or dictating.
Refresh Notes, To-Do and Journal destination icons with the current feature icon style.
Replace platform emoji mood faces with expressive vector artwork in Journal mood selection, cards, calendar and history.
Simplify the Finance drawer and group secondary tools in expandable sections.
